## Severity
Select one and apply the matching GitHub label:

- [ ] Critical — Core system unusable, data loss, or severe security issue
- [ ] High — Major feature broken with no practical workaround
- [ ] Medium — Feature partly broken; a workaround exists
- [ ] Low — Minor visual, wording, or usability issue
